cymatic_to_rhythm.title: Cymatic Interference → Rhythm Combat Grade Patterns
cymatic_to_rhythm.source: UMelodiaCymaticsSubsystem (ModeN/ModeM, SampleCymaticAmplitude, BeatPulse, BassIntensity) + MelodiaMusicClockSubsystem (BeatPhase, TempoBPM)
cymatic_to_rhythm.contract: Cymatic mode indices become a rhythm-difficulty and grade-distribution driver. The mapping is presentation→difficulty, never damage: rhythm grades still resolve only through the stock resolver.

fields.mode_to_niche: ModeN (bass-driven, radial) → EMelodiaRhythmNiche family bias: low N (1-3) → Calm (heal), mid N (4-5) → Sad (debuff), high N (6-8) → Vigorous (damage/crit). ModeM (beat-driven, cross) → NoteDensity/ActiveBeats scaling.
fields.amplitude_to_rhythm_window: SampleCymaticAmplitude(U,V) nodal amplitude → FMelodiaRhythmWindows tolerance: |amp|≈0 (nodal line) → tight window (Perfect requires ±18ms), |amp|≈1 (antinode) → forgiving window (Perfect ±45ms). Lets a performer 'play the standing wave'.
fields.beat_phase_to_cymatic_pulse: MelodiaMusicClockSubsystem.BeatPhase/BeatPulse already drives ModeM; close the loop: on BeatPhase wrap (new beat) advance ModeN/M by BassIntensity delta, then publish the consulted ProposedMIDI via rhythm skill TempoBPM — so cymatic interference and rhythm highway share the same clock (Harmonix or Quartz) without a second transport.
fields.grade_feedback_to_chladni: On FMelodiaAuthoritativeRhythmResult commit, map Grade→Chladni energy impulse: Perfect=+1.0, Great=+0.6, Good=+0.3, Miss=0.0 — write as a transient bump to BeatPulse (clamped) so a strong run visibly 'excites' the plate. Never mutates score or damage.

integration_points.read_path: MelodiaCymaticsSubsystem::GetCymaticMode + SampleCymaticAmplitude are BlueprintPure — call from rhythm HUD/skill authoring to set NoteDensity/RhythmWindows without touching combat authority.
integration_points.write_guardrail: Cymatics never calls MelodiaRhythmCombatSubsystem::SubmitResult or the stock resolver. The arrow is cymatic → difficulty/presentation only.
integration_points.pcg_bridge: Reuse MelodiaPCGWaterGameplayBridgeComponent.GradeStrength pattern: add optional UMelodiaCymaticRhythmBridgeComponent (spec only) with TMap<EMelodiaSkillGrade,float> CymaticImpulseStrength, mirroring the water bridge's grade map.
integration_points.world_field_bus: Publish ModeN/ModeM + BeatPulse as WorldField.Resonance and WorldField.Tension (read-only) so materials/PCG/Niagara can taste rhythm without coupling to the battle subsystem.

cymatic_to_water.title: Cymatic Standing Waves → Water Ripple Animation
cymatic_to_water.source: UMelodiaCymaticsSubsystem (Chladni amp, ModeN/M, BeatPulse/BassIntensity) + MelodiaMusicClockSubsystem (BeatPhase, TempoBPM, Harmonix/Quartz source)
cymatic_to_water.target: Water presentation + simulation: MelodiaWaterInteractionSubsystem, MelodiaWaterFluidZoneComponent (CPU height-field), MelodiaWaterRippleMaterialBridgeComponent (M_Water_Master_Grand_v9 3-slot ripple), MelodiaWaterNiagaraBridgeComponent (NDC), MelodiaPCGWaterGameplayBridgeComponent (ResonancePulse), MelodiaWaterProfile tier ladder
cymatic_to_water.contract: Cymatics drives water presentation (ripples/MPC/Niagara/fluid impulses) — never water gameplay state. Gameplay state (levels/pressure/routes/puzzles) stays owned by MelodiaWaterGameplaySubsystem via ResonancePulse operations. Presentation reads cymatics; gameplay is gated.

fields.chladni_to_ripple: SampleCymaticAmplitude mapped to RippleCenter slots: sample on a 3-point cymatic lattice (U,V) = (0.33,0.33),(0.66,0.33),(0.50,0.70) — three amplitudes → three RippleCenterA/B/C vectors on MelodiaWaterRippleMaterialBridgeComponent. Impulse = |amp| * BeatPulse, so antinodes pulse hardest. Write via existing FluidEnergy/FluidPeak or RippleImpulseA/B/C params — no new material params needed in v1.
fields.beat_to_impulse: On MelodiaAudioReactivePresentationSubsystem beat wrap (LastBeatPhase decrease) emit a FMelodiaWaterFluidImpulse to MelodiaWaterFluidZoneComponent with ImpulseGain = BassIntensity * 0.8 + BeatPulse * 0.2. Tier downgrade allowed (bAllowTierDowngrade) so AnalyticSurface maps still receive a impulse when ShallowWater2D is not active.
fields.tension_to_surface: WorldField.Tension (from cymatic ModeN/M spread — high (N−M) = high tension) → WaterBody WaveSpeed / HeightDamping: tension↑ → WaveSpeed↑ + HeightDamping↓ (taut membrane). WorldField.Resonance (BeatPulse*BassIntensity) → SurfaceRoughness / ToonRimStrength (resonant shimmer). Both stay in presentation, routed through MelodiaWaterRippleMaterialBridgeComponent's Substrate-toon params (ToonLightBands, ToonRimStrength, SurfaceRoughness) and MelodiaWaterProfile.
fields.harmonic_channel: MelodiaWaterChannelTag.Harmonic / Dissonant / Crescendo / Diminuendo map to cymatic consonance: amp sign-coherent across sampled points → Harmonic channel (constructive), sign-mixed → Dissonant. Use as ResonanceChannel in FMelodiaWaterOperationRequest when the optional gameplay bridge is enabled (spec flag bEnableCymaticResonanceGameplay=false by default — quarantined).
fields.niagara_data_channel: MelodiaWaterNiagaraBridgeComponent.ContactDataChannel can carry cymatic-tinted intensities: Intensity = base WaterContactEvent.Intensity * (0.5 + 0.5*|SampleCymaticAmplitude|), so Niagara contact particles inherit the standing-wave envelope without a new system.

integration_points.material_bridge: MelodiaWaterRippleMaterialBridgeComponent already discovers MID slots and shifts 3 ripple slots — feed it cymatic samples instead of (or in addition to) contact events when bWriteNativeWaterParameters is true. Existing params RippleCenterA/B/C, RippleImpulseA/B/C, FluidEnergy/FluidPeak are sufficient.
integration_points.fluid_zone: MelodiaWaterFluidZoneComponent.HandleFluidImpulse + GridResolution 32×32 + WriteMaterialTelemetry — cymatic impulse arrives as FMelodiaWaterFluidImpulse, stepped with FixedStepSeconds 1/30, normalized energy written to MPC FluidEnergy/FluidPeak for materials to taste.
integration_points.gameplay_firewall: If cymatic→gameplay ResonancePulse is ever enabled, it MUST go through MelodiaWaterGameplaySubsystem.ApplyResonance / MelodiaPCGWaterGameplayBridgeComponent.SubmitResonance with MinimumAcceptedGrade gating and puzzle/route ids — never directly mutate FMelodiaWaterNodeState. Default: presentation-only (no ApplyOperation from cymatics).
integration_points.world_field_bus: Publish cymatic→water as WorldField.Contact (ripple centers) and WorldField.Reaction (impulse magnitudes) — the two water-relevant bus fields — so Niagara, materials, and Houdini fields share one spatial truth.

evidence_required: Offline: MelodiaCymaticsSubsystem IsReadOnlyByContract() + MelodiaWaterRippleMaterialBridgeComponent reads 3 RippleCenter params — compatible slot count (3 cymatic samples → 3 ripple slots).
Offline: MelodiaWaterFluidZoneComponent tier ladder accepts EMelodiaWaterSimulationTier::AnalyticSurface impulse when ShallowWater2D not active (bAllowTierDowngrade).
Live PIE: with water zone + cymatics active, observe RippleImpulseA/B/C pulse on beat wraps at BassIntensity=0.8, then damp with HeightDamping 1.5 — record FluidEnergy trace and WPO vertex path.
cymatic_to_water.next_step_spec: Spec UMelodiaCymaticWaterBridgeComponent (optional, spec-only): inputs = CymaticsSubsystem + WaterInteractionSubsystem; outputs = 3 cymatic-lattice samples → RippleMaterialBridge PushRipple + FluidZone impulse; property bEnableGameplayResonance=false quarantined. No second writer — it reads MPC_Melodia_Palette via CymaticsSubsystem and writes only to water presentation params.

cross_material_pbr.title: Cross-System PBR Material Mapping — Cymatic PBR ↔ Water PBR ↔ Wardrobe PBR
cross_material_pbr.source: Copernicus cymatic PBR (9 maps × 21 variants = 189 cymatic textures proven) + Faraway P2 fabric PBR (6 suites × 7-8 maps = 47 textures proven, spec'd to P2 MIs) + Water PBR (M_Water_Master_Grand_v9 + v10 native/substrate toon — SurfaceMaterial/UnderwaterMaterial, ToonLightBands/ShadowSoftness/RimStrength, SurfaceRoughness/Metallic/SubsurfaceWeight, Bioluminescence params)
cross_material_pbr.target: Unified material pipeline: Copernicus dress bake / petal / fabric sheen / terrain→Nanite + PCG + Master/MI orchestration (M_Master_Toon_Universal, M_Master_Nikki, M_Master_Toon_Universal_Alpha, M_Water_Master_Grand_v9, M_AudioReactive_BaseMaster) + T3D material inject pipeline
cross_material_pbr.contract: Three discipline PBR sets share one orchestration flow: Houdini/Copernicus manufactures → MI instances author → native validation → T3D inject (when editor live) → static_gates fingerprint. No new master is introduced for cymatics or Faraway unless an audit proves a gap.

pbr_map_unification.convention: All sets use the same map vocabulary so MIs are interchangeable: BaseColor(BC), Normal(N), Roughness(R), AO, Height(H), ORM (Occlusion/Rough/Metal packed), Metallic(M), Emissive(E), Opacity/Alpha, Sheen, Iridescence, Mask. Cymatic manifest lists BaseColor/Normal/Roughness/Metallic/Height/ORM/Emissive/Iridescence/Opacity — align by renaming ORM↔AO packing once, then reuse.
pbr_map_unification.cymatic_set: 9 maps per variant — Height carries the Chladni standing-wave relief, Normal its derivative, Emissive/Iridescence the antinode glow. Tileable fBm already baked for tiling.
pbr_map_unification.faraway_set: 7-8 maps per suite — H/Height is weave/brocade relief, Sheen is fabric specular (Nikki path), Alpha/Mask for lace, ORM for packed workflow. Roughness pre-tuned (0.32 silk → 0.92 velvet).
pbr_map_unification.water_set: Profile-driven: SurfaceMaterial + UnderwaterMaterial MIs expose SurfaceRoughness/SurfaceMetallic/SurfaceSubsurfaceWeight + WaterBioluminescenceWeight + Substrate toon (ToonLightBands, ToonShadowSoftness/Tint, ToonRimStrength, ToonSpecularBand, ToonHighlightTint). Height/Normal come from native/baked shallow water or cymatic impulse.
pbr_map_unification.shared_orm_packing: All three traffic ORM as packed Occlusion/Rough/Metal — do not author separate per-channel textures. Copernicus bakes it; Faraway suites already ship it; water reads it via profile.
